attr.title: Five Nights at Freddy's
attr.desc: Welcome to your new summer job at Freddy Fazbear's Pizza, where kids and parents alike come for entertainment and food! The main attraction is Freddy Fazbear, of course; and his two friends. They are animatronic robots, programmed to please the crowds!
attr.inst: Downloads the latest version of the game on steam and place the FiveNightsatFreddys.exe into fnaf1/gamedata
